result.brief: 以预训练视频生成器结合仿真标定渲染与双视角重建，生成可定制的人形 loco-manipulation 参考轨迹，并训练跟踪策略在 Unitree G1 上部署。
result.reason: Uses pretrained video generation to synthesize humanoid loco-manipulation references for policy training; main contribution is robot reference generation and tracking, i.e., embodied world-model application.
